# Deadwood Reblooms v1.1.1 / 枯木逢春 v1.1.1

此版本提供 **DoL 0.5.12.13** 与 **DoL 0.5.11.9** 两套构建。只安装与你的游戏版本对应的主包；动态音乐音频包仍为可选。需要[秋枫白桦框架 5.1.1 或更新版本](https://github.com/MaplebirchLeaf/SCML-DOL-maplebirchFramework)。

## 修复与调整

- 修复“更长遭遇战”打断原版狼穴等动物车轮战的队列推进，造成敌人数反复恢复、战斗无法结束的问题。
- 修复自购房浴室洗澡后无法穿回原衣；补齐浴巾与浴袍选项，并按原版处理双臂被束缚时的洗澡流程。
- 修复悉尼同居场景中的战斗状态与人物位置、部分亲密剧情入口，以及自购房的访问、卧室选项和室内显示问题。
- 调整罗宾钓鱼、经营与关系互动，以及凯拉尔、惠特尼、多伦和西里斯的日常场景。
- 优化部分提示文字、翻译和链接排版。

下载对应主包：`deadwood-reblooms-0.5.12.13-v1.1.1.modpack` 或 `deadwood-reblooms-0.5.11.9-v1.1.1.modpack`。音频包分别以 `deadwood-reblooms-audio-` 开头。Release 仅提供加密 `.modpack`。

---

This release provides separate builds for **DoL 0.5.12.13** and **DoL 0.5.11.9**. Install only the main package matching your game version. The dynamic music audio pack remains optional. [Maplebirch Framework 5.1.1 or newer](https://github.com/MaplebirchLeaf/SCML-DOL-maplebirchFramework) is required.

## Fixes and changes

- Fixed Longer Combat interrupting vanilla beast encounter queues, which could replenish the wolves and prevent the encounter from ending.
- Restored the vanilla clothing choices after bathing in an owned property, including a towel and bathrobe when available.
- Fixed Sydney cohabitation combat and location state, several intimacy entry points, and owned-property access and bedroom options.
- Refined Robin's fishing, shop and relationship scenes, alongside daily scenes for Kylar, Whitney, Doren and Sirris.
- Polished selected hints, translations and link spacing.

Choose `deadwood-reblooms-0.5.12.13-v1.1.1.modpack` or `deadwood-reblooms-0.5.11.9-v1.1.1.modpack`. Optional audio packages start with `deadwood-reblooms-audio-`. This release publishes encrypted `.modpack` files only.
